heroHeadline: 22 Fulani Civilians Executed in Mass Graves at Diafarabé; JNIM Encircles Diabou; Bamako Siege Day 17; ISGS Kills ~28 in Tillabéri Ambush
heroSubtitle: On May 15, Amnesty International and FIDH confirmed that 22 Fulani men aged 32–67 — arrested at a cattle market in Diafarabé (Mopti Region, Mali) on May 12 — were found executed in two mass graves: bound, blindfolded, transported by canoe, and slaughtered by Malian soldiers and Dozo militia. Survivors told The Africa Report: 'They slit their throats one by one.' The Malian junta has not responded. Simultaneously, ~300 JNIM fighters encircled and attacked Diabou in Gourma Province, Burkina Faso on May 14 — killing 2 and looting cattle — continuing the eastern Burkina offensive arc (Djibo May 11, Diapaga May 12–13, Diabou May 14). In Niger, ISGS ambushed security forces in Tillabéri Region on ~May 14, killing approximately 26–28 in one of the deadliest single incidents in recent months. The Bamako siege reaches Day 17: 3 of 6 main entry roads remain disrupted, the Manantali power grid is under attack, and JNIM's multi-domain infrastructure war shows no sign of abatement.
